title: Simulation 3D Robot
text: Implement robot in 3D environment, 9 inputs, 4 outputs, {Rigid body tree} sets Robot rigid body tree model; {Input type} sets the robot model source, {Actor name} sets the name of actor to represent robot in Unreal Engine scene, {Use existing Simulink 3D actor specified in the actor name prompt} uses an existing actor in the Unreal Engine scene to represent, {Sample time}, {Initial base translation} sets the initial translation of robot base, {Initial base rotation} sets the initial rotation of robot base, {Initial joint configuration}, {End effector} sets the end-effector body name, {End effector to target actor offset as an input signal}, {End effector to target actor translation}, {End effector to target actor rotation}, {Enable region-based target actor grasp approach} sets the grasp target actors automatically when target actors are within specified bounds of end, {Enable target actor grasp region as an input signal} sets the regions for grasping target actor at input, {End effector to target actor grasp region translation difference} sets the translation difference of grasp region, {End effector to target actor grasp region rotation difference} sets the rotation difference of grasp region, {Enable visual geometry visualization in 3D scene} adds rigid body tree visual geometry in 3D visualization, {Enable collision geometry visualization in 3D scene} sets the visualize rigid body tree collision geometry in 3D visualization, {Collision geometry color} sets the color of the rigid body tree collision geometry, {Collision geometry transparency} sets the transparency of the rigid body tree collision, {Enable config input signal} sets the desired robot configurations at input port, {Enable grasp settings input signals} sets the off, {Enable translation and rotation input signals} sets the translation and rotation of robot base at input, {Enable ground truth config output signal} sets the output ground truth configuration, {Enable target grasped status output signal} sets the output grasp status and {Enable ground truth translation and rotation output signal} sets the output ground truth pose of robot base. Values come from the instance.
